moods.label: Tender
moods.description: Could use a little extra care

moods.label: Full up
moods.description: A lot on my plate and mind

needs.label: Just listen
needs.hint: Hear me out, no fixing needed.

needs.label: A little affection
needs.hint: A hug, a sweet message, a little closeness.

needs.label: Some quiet
needs.hint: A bit of time to recharge. Still loving you.

needs.label: A helping hand
needs.hint: Take one small thing off my plate.

needs.label: Time together
needs.hint: A few unhurried minutes, just us.

needs.label: Reassurance
needs.hint: Remind me we’re on the same team.

appreciations.label: I admire
appreciations.starter: Something I really admire about you is…

appreciations.label: Just because
appreciations.starter: A tiny reason I’m glad it’s you…

starterPacks.title: Everyday us
starterPacks.subtitle: Little questions about your ordinary days.
questions: What’s a tiny moment from our last day together, or our last call, that keeps popping into your head?
What’s the best thing you ate this week, and would you make me try it?
Tell me about the most boring part of your day in thrilling detail.
What part of your daily routine would surprise me most if I watched it?
Which ordinary evening of ours would you happily live again, exactly as it was?
What’s the first thing you do in the morning, before anyone needs anything from you?
What’s something small I did recently that made your day a little easier?
If we had a whole lazy evening together tonight, how would you want to spend it?

starterPacks.title: A little more understood
starterPacks.subtitle: Get to know what’s going on inside.
questions: What’s been on your mind lately that you haven’t said out loud yet?
When you go quiet, how can I tell if you want company or a little time alone?
On a long, tiring day, what’s the most helpful thing I could do or say?
What’s something you love that’s hard to explain in one sentence? Try anyway.
Tell me about something you’ve changed your mind about in the last year.
What’s an interest of yours you’d love to show me instead of just telling me about?
When you’re stuck on a decision, do you want ideas, a sounding board, or just time?
What did younger you worry about that you don’t worry about anymore?

starterPacks.title: Love in the little things
starterPacks.subtitle: The small stuff that quietly says I love you.
questions: What’s something small I do without being asked that you secretly love?
When did I last make you laugh without meaning to?
What’s a little habit of mine you’d miss if it disappeared tomorrow?
When have you watched me do something and thought, ‘that is so you’?
On a low-energy day, what feels best: kind words, a call, a hug, or a silly message?
What’s a compliment you often think about me but have never actually said?
What have we gotten really good at together that nobody else would notice?
Which message or note from me have you kept, or reread more than once?

starterPacks.title: Dreaming in the same direction
starterPacks.subtitle: Small hopes and big someday plans.
questions: Which ‘someday’ plan of ours could we try a tiny version of this month?
What’s one little habit of ours you’d want to keep no matter how busy life gets?
If we could live anywhere for a year, where would you pick, and what would you want to know first?
What part of our future would you rather leave as a happy surprise than plan out?
What’s a tradition we could start this year and keep forever, wherever we are?
What’s a personal goal you’re working on that you’d love me to ask about more often?
What do you think future us will be proudest of when we look back at right now?
Describe a perfectly ordinary Tuesday for us ten years from now.

starterPacks.title: A little ridiculous
starterPacks.subtitle: Less overthinking, more giggling.
questions: Our terrarium creature files one complaint about our decorating. What does it say?
We have to open a tiny business using only skills we already have. What is it, and what goes wrong first?
What everyday object deserves its own very specific world championship?
If one of our harmless habits became an Olympic sport, what would the commentator keep yelling?
Would you rather have a pet that only talks in rhymes or one that narrates everything you do?
We swap lives for a day. At what exact moment do you call me for help?
Which of our inside jokes would be hardest to explain to a very serious judge?
If our relationship were a board game, what would the most unfair bonus card do?

starterPacks.title: Back on the same team
starterPacks.subtitle: Gentle talks for when you both feel ready.
questions: Think of a small disagreement we had. What were you really hoping I’d understand?
When one of us needs a break in the middle of a hard talk, how should we pick it back up?
When I’ve misunderstood you, what helps you feel heard again?
What could I say that would show you I got your point before I share mine?
Is there a little thing that keeps tripping us up that one simple change could fix?
After an apology, what small thing helps you really believe it?
What’s something you’d like to be able to say no to without having to explain why?
What’s one promise we could make smaller so it’s easier to keep on a rough week?

rituals.title: Soft landing
rituals.description: Put the week down and catch up on each other.

prompts.label: A bright spot
prompts.question: What moment from this week do you wish I’d been there to see?

prompts.label: The heavy part
prompts.question: What part of this week was harder than it looked from the outside?

prompts.label: A thank-you
prompts.question: What’s something I did this week that you never got around to thanking me for?

prompts.label: Next week
prompts.question: What’s one small thing that would make next week go better for both of us?

rituals.title: Little exhale
rituals.description: For the end of a long week, when you just want a softer evening.

prompts.label: Leave it here
prompts.question: What’s one thing on your mind we can set down tonight without solving it?

prompts.label: A little care
prompts.question: What looks restful but doesn’t actually recharge you, and what really does?

prompts.label: Just us
prompts.question: What would feel good tonight, with the energy we’ve got left?

rituals.title: Two-of-us pause
rituals.description: A small date night with a little extra heart.

prompts.label: In sync
prompts.question: When this week did it feel like we were totally on the same wavelength?

prompts.label: Still curious about you
prompts.question: What have you started reading, watching, or trying lately that you want to tell me about?

prompts.label: More of this
prompts.question: What part of tonight would you love for us to do again soon?

rituals.title: Little wins
rituals.description: Celebrate the good stuff from this week, no win too small.

prompts.label: Tiny trophy
prompts.question: What’s a small win from your week that deserves a round of applause?

prompts.label: Thank you for
prompts.question: Who made your week a little better, and what did they do?

prompts.label: Proud of you
prompts.question: What’s something you saw me do this week that made you proud?

rituals.title: Week ahead, together
rituals.description: A quick, friendly look at the week, so it feels easier for both of you.

prompts.label: The busy bits
prompts.question: Which day this week looks fullest for you, and what would make it easier?

prompts.label: Our time
prompts.question: When can we count on a little time together this week, even just a call?

prompts.label: Something fun
prompts.question: What’s one small fun thing we could put on the calendar this week?

prompts.label: Let it wait
prompts.question: What’s one thing on your list that could happily wait until next week?

rituals.title: Silly hour
rituals.description: No deep thoughts allowed. Just giggles.

prompts.label: Week as an animal
prompts.question: If your week were an animal, which one was it, and what noise would it make?

prompts.label: Weekly award
prompts.question: What’s the most ridiculous thing that happened to you this week, and what award does it win?

prompts.label: Rename it
prompts.question: If you could rename one day of the week, what would you call it?

rituals.title: Someday, together
rituals.description: Dream a little about the life you’re building, big hopes and tiny ones.

prompts.label: Someday
prompts.question: What’s a someday plan that’s been on your mind lately?

prompts.label: Tiny first step
prompts.question: What’s the smallest step we could take toward one of our dreams this month?

prompts.label: Picture it
prompts.question: Describe a perfect ordinary day for us five years from now, from breakfast to bedtime.

rituals.title: Fresh start
rituals.description: For after a rough week. Go gently, then start the next one lighter.

prompts.label: The hard part
prompts.question: What was the toughest moment of your week, big or small?

prompts.label: A little more
prompts.question: Was there a moment this week when you could have used a little more from me?

prompts.label: Clean slate
prompts.question: Is there anything you’d like to say, or hear, so we can start next week fresh?

prompts.label: Next time
prompts.question: If a week like this comes around again, what’s one small thing that would help?

rituals.title: Rest and recharge
rituals.description: Check in on sleep, energy, and how you’re really feeling.

prompts.label: Battery check
prompts.question: If your energy were a phone battery right now, what percent would it be at?

prompts.label: Real rest
prompts.question: What’s the most restful thing you did this week?

prompts.label: Be kind to you
prompts.question: What’s one kind thing you could do for yourself this week, like an early night?

prompts.label: Cozy plans
prompts.question: What cozy little thing could we each do this weekend, together or on a call?

rituals.title: Remember when
rituals.description: A trip down memory lane, from your early days to last week.

prompts.label: Way back
prompts.question: What’s a memory from our very beginning that still makes you smile?

prompts.label: Photo flashback
prompts.question: Find an old photo on your phone. What’s the story behind it?

prompts.label: Still laughing
prompts.question: What’s a moment of ours you still laugh about?

prompts.label: Do it again
prompts.question: Which memory of ours would you most love to live all over again?

rituals.title: Closer than it looks
rituals.description: Close the distance a little, whether you’re miles apart or on the same couch.

prompts.label: Wish you were here
prompts.question: When this week did you most wish I were right there with you?

prompts.label: Show and tell
prompts.question: What’s something near you right now you’d love to show me?

prompts.label: Feeling close
prompts.question: What’s a small thing I could do this week to make you feel close, wherever we are?

prompts.label: Countdown
prompts.question: What’s the next thing we’re excited to do together, in person or on a call?

rituals.title: The month ahead
rituals.description: A cozy look at the next few weeks: the fun, the busy, and the bits for us.

prompts.label: Looking forward
prompts.question: What are you most looking forward to this month?

prompts.label: Something new
prompts.question: What’s one thing you’d love to get done or try this month?

prompts.label: Us this month
prompts.question: What’s one small thing we could do together this month just for fun?

prompts.label: Heads up
prompts.question: Is there a busy or tricky stretch coming up that you’d like me to know about?

dreamStarters.title: A weekend somewhere new
dreamStarters.text: A place we’re both curious about, with time for your kind of trip and mine.

dreamStarters.title: Make our space feel like home
dreamStarters.text: Small touches that make everyday life cozier, wherever we’re living.

dreamStarters.title: Learn something side by side
dreamStarters.text: A class, skill, or hobby we can pick up together at our own pace.

dreamStarters.title: A tradition with our people
dreamStarters.text: An easy, regular excuse to see the friends and family we love.

dreamStarters.title: A tiny creative project
dreamStarters.text: Something we make together just because it sounds fun.

dreamStarters.title: Save up for something special
dreamStarters.text: A shared treat to save toward, big or small, and an easy first step.

dreamStarters.title: Grow a little garden
dreamStarters.text: A windowsill herb, a pot on the step, or a patch of ground to look after.

dreamStarters.title: Visit someone we miss
dreamStarters.text: A trip, or a long video call, with the friends or family who live far away.

dreamStarters.title: Try something we’ve never done
dreamStarters.text: A new adventure that fits our energy, budget, and the way we get around.

dreamStarters.title: A gentler everyday rhythm
dreamStarters.text: Days with time to rest, time for our own things, and time for us.

dreamStarters.title: A book of our memories
dreamStarters.text: Collect the little everyday moments we never want to forget.

dreamStarters.title: Cheer on each other’s big goals
dreamStarters.text: A plan where we both get to grow, with a fan in the front row.

prompts.text: What’s a small thing I do that makes you feel loved, maybe without me even noticing?

What’s a little dream you’d love for us to chase together?
If our terrarium could have one ridiculous object, what would you add?
What’s something I did lately that you loved but never mentioned?
When everything feels like too much, what kind of company helps most?
When did you feel closest to me this week?
What’s a tiny detail from our early days that you still remember?
What’s a new tradition you’d love for us to start?
If our little creature wrote a review of us as a couple, what would it say?
What’s something new you’ve noticed about yourself lately?
What are you working on that could use a little cheering on?
What makes you feel at home with me, even when we’re apart?
What would a perfectly lovely, ordinary day together look like?
What’s something we usually rush that you’d love for us to slow down and enjoy?
What’s a small adventure you’re glad we had together?
What helps you feel really listened to?
Which of us would be the frog, and which would be the snail?
What’s something about me you’ve come to love more over time?
What does a perfect quiet evening look like for you these days?
Where in the world would you love for us to explore together someday?
Is there a chore or worry you’d like us to tackle more as a team?
What’s a question you wish I asked you more often?
Which inside joke of ours still makes you smile every time?
What’s a small sign that you could use a little extra care?
What’s something about us that you’re proud of?
What would you name a tiny café inside our terrarium, and what’s on the menu?
What’s one little thing you’re looking forward to with me?

landmarks.name: The hollow log
landmarks.hint: Something is rustling under the log.
landmarks.description: A sleepy ladybug has made a home in the soft wood.

landmarks.name: Mushroom grove
landmarks.hint: Three little caps. Try tapping each one.
landmarks.description: The mushrooms answer with a soft glow. You found the grove’s little melody.

landmarks.name: Moonstone cave
landmarks.hint: There is a cool breeze behind the ivy.
landmarks.description: A little cave opens into a quiet underground pool.

landmarks.name: Willow pond
landmarks.hint: Trace a ripple across the water.
landmarks.description: A school of tiny silver fish follows the ripples.

landmarks.name: The seed garden
landmarks.hint: Plant a seed, give it water, and come back in a minute.
landmarks.description: Your first little flower grew in the forest garden.

landmarks.name: Firefly grove
landmarks.hint: Come back at night. Touch the lights gently.
landmarks.description: The fireflies gather around you, then float back into the trees.

landmarks.name: The wishing well
landmarks.hint: Each of you can leave a little light here.
landmarks.description: Two little lights, one shared wish. The well remembers you both.

landmarks.name: Rainy hollow
landmarks.hint: Try a little rain and look closely.
landmarks.description: The shallow hollow fills with water, and a tiny wild frog comes to visit.

landmarks.name: The old oak
landmarks.hint: There is a folded blanket beneath the oak.
landmarks.description: A quiet place to sit, leave a note, and come back to each other.

landmarks.name: Crystal pool
landmarks.hint: A small crystal glimmers deep inside the cave.
landmarks.description: The underground water reflects a whole sky of little crystals.
